Beta 1: shuffle lets go when you turn it off, the display's animation keeps up when you switch desktops and turn down, and the compact player keeps its artwork in place. Betas are offered only to people who turned on Receive beta updates.
### Added
- **Quick EQ moves between faders.** With a fader lit, the Left and Right arrows, or A and D, light the one beside it, so you can work across the whole equalizer from the keyboard. It stops at the first and last band.
### Fixed
- **Turning shuffle off really turns it off.** Next and Previous kept following the shuffled order until you played something else. Turning shuffle off now puts what is playing back in its album, crate or playlist order, and turning it on shuffles everything still to come. The song playing carries on either way. - **The display's animation no longer freezes when you switch desktops.** Coming back to the desktop CrateDigger is on left the LED animation stuck on its last frame until the next song started. - **The animation follows the volume properly.** Turning the volume down a little made the bars drop almost to nothing. They now fall by as much as the sound does. - **Album art stays in its frame in the compact player.** A cover that is not perfectly square, or a YouTube thumbnail, spilled out of its frame and ran into the display. - **Quick EQ keeps hold of the fader you moved to.** Moving the pointer off the fader you first pointed at no longer lets go of the one the keys moved to, as long as it stays over the equalizer.

A small update that tidies how the window sizes and sits on screen.
### Fixed
- **The window keeps its minimum size while you drag it.** It could be dragged far narrower than the console fits, which cut off the controls along the bottom. It now stops at 1200 by 820 points, or the size of the screen if that is smaller. - **The compact player opens in the middle of the screen.** Folding the console into the compact player used to leave it hanging from the full window's top corner, or wherever you last left it. It now lands centred, at the width you last gave it. - **POSITION and VOLUME sit evenly in the bottom bar.** On a wide window the two faders used to crowd the transport keys and leave a wide empty gap at each end. Each one now sits in the middle of its half, with the same space to the window's edge as to the keys.

CrateDigger 2.3 is here. A compact player folds the whole console into one slim unit, Secure Mode rips CDs with every sector read twice and checked, rip settings start from the medium, small pictures on the display show what CrateDigger is working on, and the equalizer gets six user presets and Quick EQ from the keyboard. 2.3.0 went out only as betas, so everything listed under 2.3.0 below is new in this release as well.
### Added
- **Six user EQ presets.** The equalizer has a full row of six user keys under the built-in curves, up from three. The presets you already saved stay where they were. - **Quick EQ.** Turn on QUICK EQ at the top of the equalizer, point at a fader and press the Up and Down arrows, or W and S, to move it half a decibel at a time. The fader you are pointing at lights up, and while it does the arrows move it rather than the volume. Shortcuts with Command still work as usual. QUICK EQ stays on until you turn it off. - **SQUIG.LINK in the equalizer.** A key opens squig.link in your browser, where reviewers publish measurements and EQ for hundreds of headphones and IEMs. - **How to import a headphone preset,** in three steps under the faders: find your headphones on squig.link, press Auto EQ and then Export in its Equalizer tab, then press IMPORT AUTOEQ and drop the file in. - **Busy Signals.** While a job runs, its screen on the display shows a small line drawing of the work: the disc turning as a CD rips, the laser walking the sectors in Secure Mode, files going through a press as they convert, a crate of records being flipped through as a folder is scanned, a cassette filling up as a stream downloads, and packets travelling down a cable to an iPod. When the job is done, the picture shows a check or DONE. - **Jobs on the top line.** On every other screen, a running job shows as a tiny "from, to" picture next to the indicators at the top of the display, filling up as the job goes. Up to two show at once, with +N for more. A finished job blinks there until you visit its screen, and clicking one takes you to it. They show in the compact player too. - The pictures use your theme's colours, keep to one colour when the theme is set to monochrome, and hold still when Reduce Motion is on.
### Changed
- **The display stays on DUB when a rip, download or SACD import finishes,** so you can see that it finished. A rip still moves on to SCAN when it imports what it ripped. - **An SACD import can no longer start while another job is running,** the same as a CD rip or a download. - **Lighter on your Mac and on MusicBrainz.** The preview loads a 1200 pixel image instead of originals of up to 5000, your own files are shrunk for the grid in the background, and requests to MusicBrainz keep to one a second.
### Fixed
- **An imported squig.link file is named after the headphone,** the same as an AutoEQ file already was, instead of ending in "Filters". - **Each result shows how many images it has again.** The count beside every release had stopped appearing, or said NO IMAGES for releases that have plenty, because the archive it came from has been answering slowly or not at all. The counts now come from MusicBrainz and appear about a second after the results. - **The right artwork for the release you picked.** Picking one release, going back and picking another could show the first one's images under the second. - **Honest messages.** A busy MusicBrainz no longer reads as "No releases found", the archive being down no longer reads as "No images", and "No scans" no longer appears while Discogs is still loading. Each source shows its own progress, with TRY AGAIN when it fails. - **Searching stops when you move on.** Closing the panel, going back or starting a new search stops what was still loading, so an old search can no longer replace newer results. - **Discogs no longer waits for the archive.** Both load at the same time. - **The MEDIA filter sees every disc in a set,** so a CD and DVD release appears under DVD too, and HD means the same thing in the list and in the grid. - **Return runs the search** from either field.
